We invite five volunteer designers familiar with OpenSCAD to evaluate based on the following criteria: Readability (Red) measures how clear and understandable is the edited code to a human designer. Reusability (Reu) refers to what extent can the edited code be reused or extended to other 3D objects. Preservation (Pre) represents how well the edited code maintains the original functionality while eliminating errors.
